product: WRS Health Web EHR and Practice Management System

components.name: BillingReport.csv
components.description: Financial transactions with provider. Includes patient information, transaction dates, charges, claims and the description of transactions made with status.

components.name: CCDA.xml
components.description: XML file export of patient's clinical data. HL7 CCDA compliant with USCDI Version 1 requirements.

components.name: demographics.csv
components.description: Patient's key information, identification details, contact information, insurance information etc.

components.name: schedule.csv
components.description: Record of the patient's encounters with specific information including appointment date, provider, location, appointment type, workflow, notes and date on which notes are recorded.
documented_content_hints: date on which notes are recorded

components.name: PatientDocumentFiles.csv
components.description: CSV mapping file that contains the list of patient documents. Outlines contents of supporting attachments in the Documents folder.

components.name: Documents/
components.format: Mixed (PDF, DOCX, XLS, XML, HTML, DAT, JPG, GIF, PNG)
components.description: Folder containing patient's supporting documents or attachments when available - attachments, lab results, any documents uploaded to the patient's account.

components.name: Notes/
components.description: Encounter notes created during patient visits. Each note in HTML format with CSS, images, and JavaScript for readable formatting.
components.filename_convention: References patient name, patient ID, date of encounter, note type

components.name: Notes/PatientNoteFiles.csv
components.description: CSV mapping file that contains a list of patient notes generated during the export.

components.name: Notes/NOTES.LOG
components.description: Data file containing logs of successfully exported notes as well as any notes that encountered errors during the export process.
